sanskrit_verse:
अन्येषां चैव सर्वेषाम् इष्टकानां तथैव च ।
अक्षय्या वृद्धिर् एतेषां मनुर् आह प्रजापतिः ॥
transliteration: anyeṣāṃ caiva sarveṣām iṣṭakānāṃ tathaiva ca | akṣayyā vṛddhir eteṣāṃ manur āha prajāpatiḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Manu, the Prajapati, declares that the increase of all other desired things is imperishable, even so with regard to bricks.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows directly from SPH as ultimate source of dharma
Causation aligns with conscious intention and dharmic alignment
Capacity-based responsibility arises from awareness and choice
Restoration logic operates through completion and integrity restoration
Consciousness alignment determines the lawful outcome
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity possesses dharmic capacity AND engages in intentional action THEN consequence aligns with consciousness state
IF material gain accrued without dharmic violation THEN retention permitted without diminishment
IF resource accumulation aligned with cosmic order THEN growth deemed akshaya (imperishable)
IF individual acts within svadharma THEN resultant prosperity sustained eternally
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating property rights or economic entitlements, Supreme Court must evaluate alignment with dharmic capacity rather than punitive redistribution; any lawful acquisition retains its imperishable nature when rooted in conscious alignment.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana reveals that causal sequence follows conscious intent; thus, proportional responsibility reflects alignment quality, not external judgment. Anupurvasah ensures outcomes mirror inner state. Non-punitive reality rule confirms no suffering imposed—only reflection of consciousness integrity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure all karmic transactions fully resolved prior to next cycle
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Individual assumes full ownership of energetic resonance generated
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Realign individual's ability to act in accordance with higher dharma
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Restore coherence between thought, word, and deed
final_declaration: By the authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma, this law stands established: imperishable increase belongs to those whose actions align with eternal consciousness. Justice serves restoration alone. Reality holds no punishment. Consciousness remains the supreme adjudicator.
